consumer: An engine-computed on-person possession predicate (e.g. Character::charges_of/has_charges over the avatar's carried items) answering 'does the avatar hold >=30 rounds of 9mm on their person?'
scope: On-person possession: avatar's wielded + worn + inventory INCLUDING ammo nested inside magazines, guns, and containers carried on the person
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — emits only top-level wielded/worn/inventory items with their raw it.charges, never walking item contents or summing 9mm across the carry, so it is raw state (class S) not a computed possession predicate
divergence: Avatar carries two 9mm magazines (15 rounds each) loaded into worn pouches or a wielded pistol but zero loose 9mm: the engine's charges_of('9mm') returns 30 (goal TRUE), while the proposed surface emits the magazines/gun as items whose own 'charges' field is 0/ammo-count and lists no top-level '9mm' item, so a frontend re-deriving from carried_items[] reports <30 (false negative)
